name: Candy Rangers
description:
Hello! Welcome to the ranger system! I'll be your guide throughout the Steam page.

Firstly, I'll give you a rundown of your basic moves.

Shooting

  • Candy, you can shoot bullets sideways.

  • Mint can shoot them vertically.

  • Plum shoots them back and forth.

  • And lastly, Lemon’s bullets can clear diagonal formations.

Melee attack

Your weapon is not merely a gun! Parry or hook to special objects to advance through the levels!

Jump, Dash and Brake

Jump over obstacles, dash to go faster or brake if you're feeling overwhelmed!

Let's go over every reward you can earn on each level now. They are as follow:

Ranking

Score 5 stars ranks!

You will be ranked based on your performance.

Try not to break the chain or get hit as that will hurt your ranking!

Memories

Get a memory picture every time you clear a level with a high score!

Ranger Medals

Find ranger medals!

They unlock levels and sometimes even boss encounters!

And that's about it! I'll let you discover everything else as you go! Good luck!

Features

  • More than 20 playable levels with its secret paths.

  • 4 playable characters.

  • Loads of different enemies and stages, each taking place in a different time of day!

  • 4 bosses to fight, and a final fight across the entire map!

  • Split your team to take on 2 paths at the same time!
    Take on hard mode. You'll receive twice the time penalty for each hit you take. Become untouchable!

  • Inky Mode! Once you beat the game, you will unlock new modes to play. Inky can shoot in all directions. Everything goes!

  • Beat the game to try the arcade mode. Can you beat every level without taking a break?
